Interaction-shape divergences, declared deliberately (loud, not silent — same doctrine as the register's deferred rows). Each token keys an OO control that opens a modal/menu while WO acts directly with no surface. These are intentional: WO's direct action (insert-at-caret, toggle, inline marker) is the chosen UX, not a missing dialog. Verified 2026-09-12 against OO 8-x rig + WO @ebbb4c15a.. Backstage tokens (download/protect/info/settings/help) added 2026-10-04 from the first OO backstage interaction capture (interact-oo.cjs, rig DS 9.4). Portal-mode backstage tokens (create/recent) added 2026-10-04 (portal-mode rig capture).
9 tokens (dropcap, linenumbers, hyphenation, watermark, pagecolor, colors, add-text, update-table, displaymode) PROMOTED to real OO-parity option modals 2026-10-07 (round 2, like round-1 notes/pagenumber/headerfooter/trackchanges) — removed from the declared list; the interaction ledger now classifies them ok (modal<->modal).
backgroundplugins: background plugin mode is a quiet ribbon toggle (aria-pressed + status), not a dialog; OO opens a plugin picker
insert-image: image insertion is the anchored popover on every tab; OO uses a modal only from header/footer context
asc-gen673: OO header/footer 'Close' opens a confirm; WO exits header mode directly
smartart: WO opens the SmartArt dialog directly; OO first opens a type-picker menu (verified 2026-10-03, interact census dropdown pass)
text-fromfile: WO triggers a native file picker (hidden input) then imports (docx via /api/documents import); no DOM modal — verified wired editor.js:6213
mailmerge: WO triggers a native CSV file picker then loads headers/rows; no DOM modal — verified wired editor.js:6246
speech: WO read-aloud is a direct TTS action with a control surface; OO opens a modal
speechinput: WO dictate is a direct STT action (Web Speech API); OO opens a modal
download: OO Download-As is a full-screen backstage section; WO btn-export opens the export sublist (menu) — intentional surface-kind difference (structural MAP pairs them; both deliver the export actions)
protect: OO Protect is a backstage section; WO opens a modal dialog — intentional surface-kind difference
info: OO Info is a backstage section; WO opens a modal dialog — intentional surface-kind difference
settings: OO Advanced Settings is a backstage section; WO opens a modal dialog — intentional surface-kind difference
help: OO Help is a backstage section; WO opens a modal dialog — intentional surface-kind difference
create: OO Create New opens a backstage template panel; WO btn-new acts directly (replaces the document content, no surface) — intentional
recent: OO Open Recent opens a backstage recent-files panel; WO btn-open uses the native file picker (no observable DOM surface in headless) — intentional
